provenance.hypothesis_generation_note: V2 was proposed after observing V1 directional failure and the target-region ship/frozen geometry. Therefore target-period anchors are discovery data and cannot validate V2.

fixed_model.name: RECIPROCAL_TOBI_GYRO_LAYBACK_V2
fixed_model.external_cable: time-interpolated archived PRISM input cd169.cable final numeric field
fixed_model.depth_term: per-ping raw TOBI median pressure_raw/10-5 used as metre-equivalent vertical term
fixed_model.vehicle_position_formula: geodesic destination from interpolated ship position along layback_bearing by horizontal_layback_m
fixed_model.gyro_transform: circular mean of eight samples after raw/10 - 10.1 deg calibration already used in prior frozen target parser

discovery_region_excluded_from_validatio.reason: target-period geometry influenced V2 hypothesis generation

validation.directional_repair_dominance_pass: V2 heldout residual median < V1 heldout residual median AND V2 heldout residual p90 < V1 heldout residual p90
forbidden: drop bad heldout anchors after seeing residuals

target_mapping_after_validation_metrics_.cross_track_formula: project target minus reconstructed vehicle into raw TOBI heading frame

interpretation_ceiling.em12_state: independent Earth-fixed EM12 bathymetry already covers frozen cell in two processed line groups; it does not retroactively validate V2 navigation
